G-d's declaration of what lies in man's innermost speech is itself peace.

 The first letters of "And Noach found favor in the eyes of Hashem" (ו׳נח מ׳צא ח׳ן ב׳עיני י׳י) [Genesis 6:8] spell מביחו (meviacho — a word whose meaning is developed in the source).

 The phrase "and abundant in lovingkindness" (ורב חסד) [Exodus 34:6] five times = gematria of אלף תיו ה׳ — the letters of אתה ("You") spelled out as Alef-Tav-Heh.

 Chayay Mooharan §136

 ורבים מישנ'י אדמ'ת עפ'ר יקיצ'ו

The resurrection of the dead contains within its final letters the name of the great convert.

 ורפא ירפא
 
 Gematria

 "He shall surely heal" (ורפא ירפא) [Exodus 21:19 — the Torah's authorization for physicians to heal] — together with the two words, their gematria equals פדיון נפש (pidyon nefesh, "redemption of the soul"). Healing of the body is the redemption of the soul.
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:3

 ו'תורתך ל'א ש'כחתי

 The first letters of "and Your Torah I have not forgotten" (ו׳תורתך ל׳א ש׳כחתי) [Psalms 119:109] spell שלו (shalev, "tranquil / at peace").

 ז׳ שמות

 זיעה / ז'ה ה'יום ע'שה י'י
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 Zeiah (זיעה, "perspiration / sweat") — its letters are the first letters of ז׳ה ה׳יום ע׳שה י׳י: "This is the day that Hashem has made" [Psalms 118:24].

 Roshay Saveivos (×2)

 The month of Tamuz (תמוז — written deficiently, without the Vov: תמז) yields two first-letter sources:

 (1) ז׳כרו ת׳ורת מ׳שה — "Remember the Torah of Moshe" [Malachi 3:22];

 (2) ז׳מן מ׳תן ת׳ורתינו — "the time of the giving of our Torah" [the liturgical phrase for Shavuos].
